races.name: SVE Services Ltd Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Chief Black Robe
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who benefits from the anticipated strong pace but his recent form suggests he may lack the class despite dropping in the weights
runners_data.comment: Difficult times since back from absence; dropped right down weights; not disgraced latest
runners_data.spotlight: Difficult times since back from absence last June but he's dropped a long way in the weights and there have been some signs of life; non-stayer over the extended 3m3f at Stratford recently (Carpe Diem runner-up) but he didn't run badly and better is expected.

runners_data.name: Redbridge Rambler
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent form behind winners but may get caught up in the early pace battle between the confirmed leaders
runners_data.comment: Two good runs over 3m1f in late 2025; inadequate trip latest; solid chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two good runs behind subsequent winners at Hereford and Catterick (both 3m1f, good) in late 2025; always struggling over an inadequate 1m7f at Wincanton (no headgear; cheekpieces return) in April and perhaps fortunate to get dropped 2lb; fair chance of another win.

runners_data.name: Black Occ
runners_data.note: Prominent style with jumping concerns after recent pulls-ups, though his Hereford second suggests ability when getting the trip right
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in 2 of 3 chase starts but creditable second in March (2m5f); should do better
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in two of three chase starts, the latest at Bangor after some guessy jumps; had run well when runner-up at Hereford (2m5f, good) in March, however, and should do better at some stage; tongue tied this time.

runners_data.name: Sweet Nightingale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven chase form including a 3m win at Exeter, ideally positioned tactically for this race shape
runners_data.comment: Won 3m chase at Exeter in March; had excuses since; this sharp 3m can suit; close up
runners_data.spotlight: Went chasing late in her career but she's making a good fist of it and was going best from some way out when winning at Exeter (3m, good) in March; no blame attached for defeat next time and she didn't appreciate the 3m2f trip at Fontwell recently; a sharp 3m should suit; close up.

runners_data.name: Bahtiyar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been consistent in the frame recently and should benefit from the expected strong gallop over this staying trip
runners_data.comment: 0-30 over hurdles and fences but in the frame on last 5 starts, two of them here
runners_data.spotlight: 0-30 over hurdles and fences but in the frame on last five starts, two of them here (3m1f/2m4f); deserves to find a race and he should be involved again providing this doesn't come too soon after his run on Tuesday.

runners_data.name: Carpe Diem
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who will set the pace but may pay for his aggressive tactics over this extended distance
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin 2m4f winner in February; up weights; creditable 3m3f run latest; good claims
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark when well clear at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) in February but paid the handicapping price after; it's been harder since but he was unfortunate to run up against one who relished the new 3m3f test at Stratford (good) in April, although he still ran well; major player in first 3m run.

runners_data.name: School For Scandal
runners_data.note: Lead horse with course experience and a 4lb weight drop, though his 11-year-old legs may not handle a truly searching gallop
runners_data.comment: Mixed over the winter but 4lb lower than November win (3m) so has a weights chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two more chase wins in 2025, the latest at Windsor (3m, good to soft; suited by good) in November; often battled with unsuitable ground over the winter but 4lb lower than at Windsor so has a weights chance.

runners_data.name: Stonegate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest form and recent pull-ups, running from 9lb out of the weights making his task extremely difficult
runners_data.comment: Modest form over jumps and pulled up on last three chase starts; can only watch
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form over jumps so far and has been pulled up on last three chase starts; can only watch from 9lb out of the weights.

races.paceDynamic: Carpe Diem and School For Scandal will contest the early pace over this testing three-mile trip at Warwick. Both confirmed front-runners should ensure a solid gallop from the start, with Carpe Diem likely to be more aggressive given his recent prominent tactics. The honest pace will stretch the field over the latter stages of this stamina test. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can stay the extended trip and finish strongly when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go too hard early and fade from three out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses who can use their stamina reserves in the closing stages. Sweet Nightingale and Chief Black Robe are ideally positioned to capitalize on this scenario given their proven staying ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Carpe Diem or School For Scandal can dictate at a controlled pace
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters could steal a march by moderating the gallop and having enough left for a telling kick. School For Scandal's recent course form and lighter weight make him the more likely beneficiary of this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can track the leaders without over-racing
scenarios.body: Redbridge Rambler could benefit from sitting just off the pace-setters and timing his challenge perfectly. His recent good form behind subsequent winners puts him in prime position if he can avoid getting caught up in the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters falter dramatically before the final circuit
scenarios.body: A very strong early gallop could see all the front-runners capitulate, leaving the race to the most patient hold-up horses. This extreme scenario would suit the deepest closers but requires a particularly demanding pace that may not materialize.

watchPoints.text: Carpe Diem and School For Scandal could go too fast early and both collapse, creating chaos in the betting markets
Black Occ's jumping reliability after recent pull-ups could affect the pace dynamic if he interferes with the prominent pack
Sweet Nightingale's position turning for home will indicate whether the pace has been strong enough to set up her finishing kick
Bahtiyar's ability to get a clear run from his hold-up position given the small field size and potential bunching
School For Scandal's stamina reserves in the final half-mile will show whether his recent layoff has left him short of peak fitness

races.name: Mike Mohan's 60th Birthday 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Taranis Dubh
runners_data.note: Only confirmed pace-setter should get uncontested lead but disappointed as odds-on favorite at Newton Abbot last time
runners_data.comment: Leading contender on RPRs on Irish point and bumper form; player on hurdles debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won 11-runner Irish 4yo point in October on sole start in that sphere; backed into odds-on when only third of eight in Newton Abbot bumper (good) last month; that still represents the best bumper form in this field and he's respected on hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Wings Of Ayrton
runners_data.note: Completely unknown quantity making hurdles debut for Ben Pauling after 426 days off following point-to-point purchase
runners_data.comment: £50,000 buy after second in January Irish point; has joined respected yard
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 1l when second of 12 in Irish point (good to yielding) in January; bought for £50,000 the following month; pedigree suggests staying chases will be his game but still of interest on hurdles debut for respected yard.

runners_data.name: Kap De Cerisy
runners_data.note: Another newcomer from Dan Skelton's yard who won his last point by 11 lengths but faces big step up in class
runners_data.comment: £75,000 buy after Irish point win in March 2025; hood/tongue-tie on debut for top yard
runners_data.spotlight: Two starts in six-runner Irish points; 6-4 when close second in April 2024 then scored by 11l at 1-2 eleven months later; sold for £75,000 four days on and has joined leading yard; hooded and tongue tied for this hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: So Proud
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with proven bumper form on good ground but disappointed badly on hurdling debut after £100,000 purchase
runners_data.comment: £100,000 buy after bumper win; weakened on January hurdles debut; should do better
runners_data.spotlight: Attracted plenty of support when winning a Haydock bumper (good) one year ago; subsequently changed hands for £100,000 but weakened on stable/hurdling debut at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in January; disappointing if he's not capable of better.

runners_data.name: Sky Grove
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who needs strong pace to aim at and showed some ability in points before modest Hereford debut
runners_data.comment: Chased home a good prospect in second Irish point; bumper third encouraging 23 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability when second to a good one in Irish point at the start of the year and offered something to work on in a hood (retained) when third of 12 in Hereford bumper (good) on stable debut three weeks ago; might have a say on his introduction to hurdles.

runners_data.name: Dunstall Star
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse from powerful Tom George stable who got off the mark late at Ludlow but still looks green
runners_data.comment: Won moderate bumper (good) three weeks ago but attitude was pleasing; can improve
runners_data.spotlight: From the family of these connections' high-class staying chaser Nacarat; still green but off the mark at the second attempt when getting up late in five-runner Exeter bumper (good) three weeks ago; doubtful that was a strong event and he'll surely want further in time but attitude was pleasing; hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Fine Fellow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making seasonal return after 149 days off with 5lb claiming jockey taking valuable weight off
runners_data.comment: Fair third on debut but didn't build on it when well held in course bumper in December
runners_data.spotlight: Staying chasers in the family and he was outpaced before sticking on for third in good-ground bumper at Uttoxeter last May; didn't build on that when well held in course bumper (good to soft) in December; hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Peter's Last Deal
runners_data.note: Needs strong gallop to be effective but has shown consistent place form and handles good ground conditions

races.paceDynamic: Taranis Dubh is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should be allowed an uncontested lead, with prominent runners So Proud and Fine Fellow likely tracking but not pressuring early. The pace will be steady rather than searching, with hold-up horses Sky Grove, Dunstall Star and Peter's Last Deal relying on late runs from off the tempo. This should develop into a tactical affair where the early leaders can dictate terms without pressure. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can control the tempo and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Taranis Dubh gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate terms without pressure and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. Prominent racers tracking the pace also benefit from the controlled tempo and can strike at the right moment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks when the race comes to them. The early leaders may have gone too slow to resist the late charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Taranis Dubh sets steady fractions but weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The horses tracking just behind can time their move perfectly to sweep past a tiring leader. So Proud's bumper win suggests he has the class to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced point-to-point graduates shows significant improvement over hurdles
scenarios.body: Wings Of Ayrton or Kap De Cerisy could have been working exceptionally well at home and prove much better than their limited public form suggests. The winner emerges from an unexpected source.

watchPoints.text: Taranis Dubh could get such an easy lead that he's impossible to peg back if jumping fluently on debut over hurdles
Wings Of Ayrton and Kap De Cerisy are complete unknowns making debuts after big money purchases and long layoffs
So Proud showed class winning his bumper but folded tamely on hurdling debut and needs to prove that was just a learning experience
Fine Fellow returns from long break with claiming rider but trainer Alastair Ralph's 2-5 record suggests selective placement
The pace could collapse completely with only Taranis Dubh showing early speed, setting up a messy sprint finish

races.name: Subscribe To Head In Front Betting Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Danger Nap
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut with first-time cheekpieces but poor hurdles form suggests needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Made a promising start in bumpers but has shown little in three runs over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Made a promising start in bumpers but has shown little in three runs over hurdles; still early days and wears first-time cheekpieces on handicap debut up in trip; may well show improvement.

runners_data.name: Kantagua Du Large
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare from Harry Cobden who should benefit from the expected modest pace despite recent below-par effort
runners_data.comment: Fourth at Exeter and Taunton in March but below par at Ffos Las last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French mare; followed up a couple of fair efforts at Exeter and Taunton with a below-par run at Ffos Las last month; has slipped to a career-low mark and Harry Cobden rides for the first time but she's still looking for her first win in Britain and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Blue In The West
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent recent form with a win and second at Exeter, perfectly suited to the likely tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Exeter last month and second back there ten days later.
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at the 25th attempt at Exeter (2m5f, good) last month and ran well off 6lb higher when runner-up back there under identical conditions ten days later; this hold-up performer could go well again but his overall record makes him a risky proposition for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Mexican Stan
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping up in trip which should suit, though yet to be placed from seven starts over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Yet to be placed from seven runs but shapes as though this step up in trip will suit.
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to be placed from seven runs but shapes as though this step up in trip will suit; has dropped another 4lb and should do better.

runners_data.name: Silver Gale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing improvement over longer trips and good recent second at Fakenham suggests more progress possible
runners_data.comment: Has shown improvement since stepping up in trip and switching to handicaps.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown improvement since stepping up in trip and switching to handicaps, latest when runner-up at Fakenham (2m7f, good) last month; should go close here.

runners_data.name: Broadway Honey
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare lightly raced over hurdles with room for improvement despite disappointing recent handicap efforts
runners_data.comment: Best effort when third in a Hereford novice last November; below that form since.
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort over hurdles when third in a Hereford novice last November; below that form in a couple of handicaps since but she's still lightly raced and she could show more upped in trip off a sliding mark.

runners_data.name: Kingston Kid
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well handicapped on old form but disappointing in recent years and hard to trust
runners_data.comment: Well handicapped on old Irish form but lightly raced and disappointing in recent years.
runners_data.spotlight: Well handicapped on old Irish form but lightly raced and disappointing in recent years; difficult to enthuse over.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runners and most runners holding up or prominent, this sets up as a modest early gallop with the prominent runners Danger Nap and Kingston Kid likely to track any early leader. The lack of natural pace-setters means the tempo will build gradually, creating a compressed field turning for home. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, as they'll get the slow-run race they need to unleash their finishing speed over this stamina-testing 3m1f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian as expected with no genuine pace-setters
scenarios.body: The compressed field and gradual tempo allows the hold-up horses to position perfectly and unleash their finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Blue In The West, Silver Gale, and Mexican Stan all benefit from the tactical setup their running styles demand.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Danger Nap and Kingston Kid establish a stronger early rhythm than expected
scenarios.body: The prominent pair create enough tempo to stretch the field slightly, preventing the hold-up horses from getting their ideal slow-run scenario. This plays into the hands of horses positioned closer to the pace who can sustain their efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast trying to make their own luck
scenarios.body: The over-aggressive early pace catches up with the pace-setters in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Mexican Stan and Blue In The West benefit most from this energy-sapping tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace leads to a stop-start affair with multiple horses trying to make running
scenarios.body: The scrappy, muddling pace doesn't suit any running style perfectly, creating opportunities for horses with tactical speed to strike when others are still organizing. Broadway Honey could capitalize on the chaos with her versatility.

watchPoints.text: Blue In The West could be very hard to beat given recent winning form and this tactical setup perfectly suits his hold-up style
Watch for Danger Nap to be more prominent than usual early on which could create more pace than expected for the hold-up horses
Silver Gale's positioning will be key as she needs the race to develop into a staying test to show her recent improvement
If Kingston Kid or any outsider tries to make running early it could completely change the complexion and favour different profiles
Mexican Stan stepping up significantly in trip for the first time which could unlock improvement but remains unproven at this level

races.name: Lewis Badges 1832 Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Three Pikes
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on upward curve with recent Stratford win, suited by step up in trip and Oliver's 20-day freshen-up
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner in June last year and got off the mark over hurdles at Stratford last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner in June last year and got off the mark over hurdles at Stratford (2m2f, good) last month; looks sure to be suited by this step up in trip and holds claims.

runners_data.name: Impecunious
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse resuming after 293 days for new trainer Chanin, betting will reveal connections' confidence
runners_data.comment: Won twice when trained by Chris Down last year; back after 293 days off for new trainer.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice when trained by Chris Down last year; resumes following 293 days off for new trainer; betting will be best guide to his chance.

runners_data.name: Camarrate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse fresh off Newcastle win 28 days ago, up 4lb but Donald McCain's 1/12 14-day record concerning
runners_data.comment: Scored for the first time in two years at Newcastle four weeks ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Scored for the first time in two years at Newcastle (2m4f, good) four weeks ago; up 4lb and should not be far away in this follow-up bid.

runners_data.name: Il Va De Soi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to cheekpieces on career-low mark, but poor current form string makes him vulnerable
runners_data.comment: His two wins came on soft in April 2024; out of sorts over fences and hurdles this term.
runners_data.spotlight: His two wins came on soft in April 2024; out of sorts over fences and hurdles this term; cheekpieces return and has dropped to a career-low mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.

runners_data.name: Mammies Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with course-and-distance win on CV, showed promise when third at Exeter 22 days ago
runners_data.comment: Ran his best race for current trainer when third at Exeter last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times for the O'Neill's, including over C&D; ran his best race for current trainer when third of four finishers at Exeter (2m5f, good) last month when clouting the second-last; knocking on the door and should run well.

runners_data.name: Gwash
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making seasonal return after 163 days, has course form but well beaten in recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Best effort came when runner-up at Uttoxeter last July; well beaten in three runs since.
runners_data.spotlight: Sole success over hurdles came here over two years ago and his best effort came when runner-up at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last July; well beaten in three runs since, the latest on chase debut at Taunton in November; cheekpieces worn last time are left off and doesn't appeal for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Kom Tu Voudras
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut after Huntingdon maiden win, significant ground change from heavy to good
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark on her stable debut in a Huntingdon maiden in February.
runners_data.spotlight: Former Willie Mullins inmate who got off the mark on her stable debut in a Huntingdon maiden (2m4f, heavy) in February; makes handicap debut on contrasting ground and a fascinating contender here.

runners_data.name: Urban Isle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner trying cheekpieces for first time, but 0-7 record under rules and 32 days since last run
runners_data.comment: 0-7 and a beaten co-favourite on his handicap debut when sixth at Exeter last month.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 under rules and a beaten co-favourite on his handicap debut when sixth of 12 finishers at Exeter (2m5f, good) last month; first-time cheekpieces now on and still lightly raced so cannot dismiss.

races.paceDynamic: Gwash is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely to get an uncontested lead in this small field. Three Pikes, Il Va De Soi, Kom Tu Voudras and Urban Isle all show prominent tendencies but may settle closer than usual given the lack of pace pressure. The hold-up horses Impecunious, Camarrate and Mammies Boy will track the moderate gallop before making their moves turning for home. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours the hold-up merchants who can unleash finishing kicks against tired front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Gwash sets a pedestrian gallop and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and produce superior finishing bursts. Camarrate, Impecunious and Mammies Boy can all unleash devastating late kicks against a strung-out field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails Early
scenarios.trigger: If Three Pikes or Kom Tu Voudras press Gwash and create honest gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo prevents hold-up horses from closing effectively while suiting those who can travel strongly in behind the leaders. Three Pikes benefits most from his recent Stratford win and upward trajectory.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gwash Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Gwash gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: His 163-day break could have freshened him up and the lack of early pace pressure allows him to dictate throughout. The field struggles to reel in his sustained effort from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Impecunious Returns Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If the 293-day layoff has rejuvenated Impecunious under new trainer Chanin
scenarios.body: His two wins for Chris Down last year showed genuine ability and the extended break could have him primed for a big effort. Fresh legs prove decisive in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Impecunious market moves will reveal if 293-day absence has been beneficial under new trainer Chanin
Three Pikes early position as he may need to be more aggressive than usual given the lack of natural pace
Gwash's jumping rhythm early on after his 163-day seasonal break
Camarrate's finishing kick timing as he attempts to follow up his Newcastle breakthrough
Urban Isle's response to first-time cheekpieces in the closing stages

races.name: Jockey Club 0-110 Rated Series Final Open Hunters' Chase (A Grassroots Hunters' Chase Series Final)

runners_data.name: Good Source
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strongest RPR (99) but 403 days since last run creates fitness doubt despite recent point form
runners_data.comment: Has performed with credit in points this year, winning at Higham last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on his rules debut in a Fakenham maiden hunter chase (3m, good) in April 2025 and has performed with credit in points this year, winning at Higham last month; carries a 3lb penalty but should run well.

runners_data.name: Walkin Out
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with tactical advantage in small field, Miss Anna Johnston's 7lb claim valuable but horse needs to prove stamina at 3 miles
runners_data.comment: A prolific winner in points with 12 wins in that sphere.
runners_data.spotlight: Landed maiden hunter chase at Cartmel in May 2023 and a prolific winner in points with 12 wins in that sphere; beat two rivals in a point at Stafford Cross 13 days ago and she should go close.

runners_data.name: Malinas Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape, recent point wins with same jockey creates confidence but untested at this level under rules
runners_data.comment: Has made a bright start in points for his current trainer, winning twice last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; has made a bright start in points for his current trainer, winning twice last month under Heidi Palin; races prominently and should give a good account.

runners_data.name: Best Mate Dave
runners_data.note: Sole hold-up runner faces tactical disadvantage with likely slow pace, needs tempo collapse to be competitive despite 7lb claim
runners_data.comment: Last of three finishers at Leicester in February and beaten three times in points since.
runners_data.spotlight: Sole success came over hurdles in June 2023; last of three finishers at Leicester (2m6f, heavy) in February and beaten three times in points since, including in a match; has his work cut out here.

races.paceDynamic: Walkin Out will dictate terms from the front in this small field, with Good Source and Malinas Glory likely to race prominently behind the leader. With three prominent runners and only Best Mate Dave held up, there's no serious pace pressure early. The tempo will be measured but honest over 3 miles, with the real racing beginning after the second-last fence. This sustainable pace and lack of early burn-up clearly favours prominent racers who can position handy and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Walkin Out Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Walkin Out gets an uncontested lead and dictates a rhythm that suits
scenarios.body: The leader can measure out fractions perfectly and kick clear turning in, while prominent runners get first run at the leader. Miss Anna Johnston's mount has the class edge and can exploit tactical control.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Good Source and Malinas Glory press Walkin Out earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners engage in sustained battle from 4 out, creating a true staying test. Good Source's superior RPR of 99 and recent Fakenham win gives him the edge in a grinding finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Best Mate Dave gets the perfect setup
scenarios.body: The prominent trio go too slow early, leaving Best Mate Dave with a devastating late kick. Mr Philipson-Stow times his challenge to perfection as the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Malinas Glory
scenarios.trigger: If Malinas Glory's point form translates directly and others disappoint
scenarios.body: The Hannah Lewis-trained runner builds on recent point wins with Heidi Palin aboard. His prominent style catches others napping while maintaining strongest gallop to the line.

watchPoints.text: Walkin Out's jumping under pressure - any mistake when challenged could end chances given small margin for error
Good Source's fitness after 403-day absence - any signs of rustiness early could compromise prominent position
Best Mate Dave's early positioning - if he tracks closer than usual it signals pace concerns
Malinas Glory's adaptation from points to rules - different pace and jumping demands under hunter chase conditions

races.name: Claverdon FC Have Done The Double Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dennis's Honor
runners_data.note: Unknown running style with strong pedigree (dam was 2m4f chase winner) but concerning yard form with Hollinshead managing just 1/13 in last 14 days.
runners_data.comment: Yard not renowned for their exploits in bumpers and may need more time.
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam 2m4f chase winner, half-sister to 2m7f hurdle winner So Ladylike, out of point winning half-sister to useful 2m jumper Blueberry Boy; yard not renowned for their exploits in bumpers and may need more time.

runners_data.name: Nate Of Spades
runners_data.note: Unproven lightly-raced type with decent breeding but Charlie Longsdon's yard is cold (0/6 in last fortnight) which raises fitness concerns.
runners_data.comment: 40,000euros 3yo; has good pedigree and needs watching in market on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000euros foal, 40,000euros 3yo; seventh foal; closely related to point winner Fortunate Soldier, half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Sporty Jim; dam 2m2f hurdle winner, closely related to useful bumper/2m-2m3f hurdle winner Royal Guardsman; in good hands and he needs watching in market on debut.

runners_data.name: Midnight Escape
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who showed some promise last time but long absence of 156 days and low OR of 90 suggests limited ceiling.
runners_data.comment: Shaped with some promise at Market Rasen in December.
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with some promise at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) in December but isn't sure to progress much in bumpers, being first foal of a 2m4f-3m hurdle winner for his owner.

runners_data.name: Legend D'Airy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest class (OR 111) but needs strong pace to be effective and recent 45-day break may have him spot-on.

runners_data.name: Roll A Dollar
runners_data.note: Natural leader who can control tempo but modest ability (OR 85) and needs to improve significantly on Taunton third.
runners_data.comment: Beaten 18l on his rules debut when third at Taunton last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in a point in March; beaten 18l on his rules debut when third of seven at Taunton (2m, good) last month and needs to show more.

runners_data.name: Barascaria Ten
runners_data.note: Prominent type but was tailed off on debut and massive step forward required despite useful family connections.
runners_data.comment: Tailed off on his rules debut in a bumper at Chepstow in February.
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to useful chaser Escaria Ten, but he was tailed off on his rules debut at Chepstow (2m, soft) in February and will need to have improved significantly to figure here.

races.paceDynamic: Roll A Dollar will lead from the start and likely dictate terms throughout this small field, with Midnight Escape and Barascaria Ten likely to track him in prominent positions. Legend D'Airy's hold-up style means he'll need the pace to develop strongly to set up his finishing kick from the rear. With only one confirmed leader and limited early pace pressure, Roll A Dollar can control the tempo and make this a tactical affair. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid a stamina test, while hold-up horses like Legend D'Airy will struggle without genuine pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Roll A Dollar leads unchallenged and dictates a steady tempo throughout.
scenarios.body: Roll A Dollar can kick clear in the straight while prominent racers like Midnight Escape benefit from the lack of early pace pressure. Legend D'Airy faces a difficult task trying to close from the back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Roll A Dollar falters or gets headed early, leaving no clear leader.
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no natural pace-setter, creating stop-start fractions that suit versatile types. This scenario opens the door for the newcomers Dennis's Honor and Nate Of Spades to capitalize on the chaos.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Legend D'Airy gets the strong pace he needs and the leaders come back to him.
scenarios.body: A genuinely-run race allows Legend D'Airy to utilize his superior class (OR 111) and proven ability to close strongly. Ben Pauling's runner has the highest RPR (117) and can exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers shows significant improvement from their breeding.
scenarios.body: Either Dennis's Honor or Nate Of Spades capitalizes on their superior pedigrees and potential improvement. Their unknown quantities make them dangerous if showing up with fitness and ability.

watchPoints.text: Roll A Dollar's early pace-setting - if he goes too slow it kills Legend D'Airy's chances, too fast and he won't last home himself.
Legend D'Airy's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to utilize his superior class rating.
Dennis's Honor and Nate Of Spades in the market - any confident support suggests hidden ability from their connections.
Midnight Escape's fitness after 156-day layoff - may need this run despite showing promise last time out.
The pace scenario developing after the first half-mile - whether Roll A Dollar gets company or leads alone will shape the entire race.
